name: AgentReader (Axiom Works)
description: Company data for agents: UK Companies House due diligence with red flags, a multi-country KYB pack (UK/AU/CA/FR/NO/DK/FI/CH/PL/CZ/BE registries, EU VAT, GLEIF LEI, sanctions), batch registry verification, UK new-company leads and company watch. No API key: free previews without a wallet, and x402 pay-per-call in USDC on Base when a payer key is set.

AGENTREADER_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional. Private key of a dedicated, low-balance Base wallet holding USDC, used to auto-pay x402 calls. Leave it unset to get free truncated previews only.
